title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): scheduling meetings from Copilot Chat in GCC, GCC High and DoD
summary: The roadmap facts and both Integrated Apps paths are supported. Searches did not establish a scheduling-specific government-cloud licence, default or switch. The government-cloud residency statements match their cited overview, but should also acknowledge Microsoft's documented exception for optional Anthropic models used by non-federal GCC customers.

claims.claim: Microsoft's government-cloud overview says Copilot operates entirely within the customer's US government cloud tenant.
claims.quote: Microsoft Copilot is available in GCC, GCC High, and DoD, and operates entirely within the customer's U.S. government cloud tenant.
claims.fix: Attribute this assurance explicitly to the government-cloud overview and add: 'Microsoft separately documents an optional exception for non-federal GCC customers: enabling Anthropic models processes Customer Data outside the government cloud.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/copilot/implement/anthropic-non-federal-gcc, which says: 'When enabled, these Anthropic AI models process Customer Data outside Microsoft’s FedRAMP-authorized U.S. Government cloud.'

claims.claim: Microsoft's government-cloud overview says prompts, responses and generated content stay in the government cloud.
claims.quote: Prompts, responses, and generated content stay in the government cloud.
claims.fix: Keep this statement attributed to the overview, alongside the optional non-federal GCC Anthropic exception, rather than as an unconditional guarantee. Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/copilot/implement/anthropic-non-federal-gcc, which states: 'If you choose to enable Anthropic models, Customer Data will be processed in commercial environments.'
